# Pinned framework distributions

The two .tgz files are deliberate, bundled dependencies, not local runtime data.

- Source: https://github.com/CraftOS-dev/Agent-App
- Revision: 5e9c7a1e28fd4742cbb49e49188d63031f35c145 (adapters unchanged through b6d039d)
- Licence: MIT (licence texts are included in the distributions)
- SHA-256: SHA256SUMS; npm also checks the package-lock integrity values
- Packages: @a2app/rules, @a2app/adapter-core

They are byte-identical to the ones dev-studio vendors.
